validation.tests: Exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank for nonzero untied differences; otherwise Pratt ranks with 50000 sign permutations; Holm family of five
validation.ci: Median of paired instance differences, percentile bootstrap over instances, 10000 resamples
validation.timing: Original performance runs exclude secondary 5/10/20 percent diversity audit; original traces and clone diagnostics included
